_comment: Per-agent-type overrides for the flow-mutation probe lines (see src/tau2/flow/mutations.py DEFAULT_PROBE_LINES). Keys: opener (first user line on the text channel), ready (satisfies the generic advance condition), detail (a data-rich answer that drives tool usage in a collection state), ack (neutral cooperative filler). Types without an entry use the defaults, which are tuned for intake-shaped flows.

headache_enrollment.ready: Yes, I'm ready to start. Let's begin.
headache_enrollment.detail: Sure — the main reason I'm reaching out is my recurring headaches. I was born on March 3rd, 1990, and I'm female.
